description: Closes part of #410 (continuation of 054/055) — golden coverage for buildium_list_rental_owner_requests (rental-owner-submitted requests, #401), one of the 11 read tools from #400-#404 that shipped with unit tests but no agent_flow case. Mirrors 055: the question one-shots buildium_list_rental_owner_requests; the mirror aggregate tools are mocked empty so the agent takes the documented live-tool fallback. Quality/K-of-N assertions; identifier guard critical; quarantined (single_run_gate:false). DOGFOOD 2026-07-08: the model reaches buildium_list_rental_owner_requests only INTERMITTENTLY under the 57-tool schema (~3/6 sweep, 17-18/20 grid — the gemini empty-completion trips the rest), below the 19/20 bar. Anchored the ask on 'open rental-owner-submitted requests on the Buildium task board' and mocked all nine mirror tools empty; left quarantined (single_run_gate:false), tracked nightly.
